messages:
Anya: quick update — enabling fp8 kernels on H100/L40s canary (canary=5%)
Anya: started rolling to fp8-hybrid kernel on dedicated-capacity-3. seeing small but reproducible token drops on long-prefix streaming tests (~>4096)
Sam: token drops how? delete or shifted tokens?
Anya: deletes/duplication in ~0.1% of traces, looks like attention weights collapse at chunk boundaries when precision flips mid-request
Michael: could be KV cache alignment. we saw similar with gptq fallback last quarter when tiling didn't preserve per-head offsets
Nina: do we have logs/trace ID? paste sample
Anya: trace 0x7f3c9b, here's the tail of the log:
```
INFO kernel_dispatch: using fp8_hybrid_fastpath
WARN attn_merge: kv_offset_mismatch head=12 expected=2048 got=2032
DEBUG quant: fallback to int8 for matmul qkv
OUT: S- token_mismatch at pos 4096
```
Rahul: interesting — kv_offset_mismatch by 16 tokens. maybe padding/trailing tokens due to batch-level continuous batching? did the scheduler insert a warmup request
Sam: scheduler didn't. canary traffic had a 2-request burst where prefix cache was reused. might be a race between cache-evict and precision-handshake
Michael: hypothesis: the fp8 kernel's handshake assumes fixed tiling stride; when fallback to int8/gptq occurs in the same micro-batch the handoff doesn't adjust per-head stride -> misaligned KV writes
Nina: repro steps request? I can run a focused perf + correctness test on emu nodes
Anya: repro: run sample long-prefix stream with heterogeneous precision allowed and prefix-caching enabled. script below
```
python tests/longprefix_bakeoff.py --model redwood/atlas-13b --seq 8192 --canary 1 --allow-hetero
```
Sam: mitigation options
Sam: 1) disable fp8_fastpath for seq>4096
Sam: 2) force precision-stable handshake: atomic precision barrier between kernel transitions
Sam: 3) insert zero-length noop warmup request to align kv_offset before streaming
Rahul: also consider making the cache store include per-kernel-tile metadata (tile_stride, precision_tag)
Michael: we should prefer solution 2+4 (handshake + metadata) for correctness, 1 as short-term
Anya: perf impact? 2 might add ~0.5-1ms per kernel switch. canary perf numbers currently: baseline 11.2ms avg token, fp8_fastpath 9.1ms, with handshake maybe 9.6ms
Nina: I'll run canary with handshake patch on emu and report perplexity & regression harness
ci-bot: deploy pipeline started for pr#4587 (fp8/handshake) — smoke tests queued
Anya: thanks. tagging @Sam for rollout plan. please hold production full rollout until canary has zero kv_offset_mismatch for 24h
Sam: ack :thumbsup: I'll update the rollout doc and add the noop-warmup as a temporary flag
Michael: adding a unit test to kernel-sanity that simulates precision flip within same micro-batch
Nina: I'll post results in this thread in ~2h
Anya: appreciate it — if we can avoid user-visible deletions, let's be conservative on canary
